/**
 * Records the MIP-0018 proof of concept's API answers for UmbraDB's `token-metadata` (task 1.1, M14).
 *
 * Run in a checkout of acedward/umbradb at 760d3e9c8a060577257ca3b2c42dd09a680e70f8, with this file at
 * `token-indexer/test/record-answers.test.ts` and Docker running:
 *
 *   npm ci --ignore-scripts
 *   RECORD_OUT=/path/to/answers npx vitest run token-indexer/test/record-answers.test.ts
 *
 * For each of the proof of concept's recorded Stagenet ranges (`idx` 714,485–715,183 and `u1` 715,402–715,433) it does
 * what its own `mip0018-api.test.ts` does — the real chain-archive sync against the fake chain serving the range's
 * tape, then the real scanner to the range's end, then the API on 127.0.0.1 — and requests a fixed list: status; the
 * token list whole and in pages of 2; each listed identity; each listed color's token and both lookups; for every
 * contract of the list and of the case index in the range, its tokens and its events; and the events of every
 * transaction those events name. Each answer is written as `{ path, status, headers, body }` (body as text) to
 * `<RECORD_OUT>/<range>.json`, the requests in the order made. The answers depend only on the tapes, so a second run
 * writes the same bytes.
 */
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import type { Server } from "node:http";
import { PostgreSqlContainer, type StartedPostgreSqlContainer } from "@testcontainers/postgresql";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { bootstrapChainArchiveSchema } from "../../chain-archive-sync/bootstrap.js";
import { ChainArchiveSyncService } from "../../chain-archive-sync/sync-service.js";
import { createClient, type UmbraDBSql } from "../../src/postgres/client.js";
import { startFakeChain } from "../../test/integration/fixtures/stagenet-archive/fake-chain-server.js";
import { loadCaseIndex, loadRangeTape } from "../../test/integration/fixtures/stagenet-archive/stagenet-fixtures.js";
import { createMip0018Api, listen } from "../mip0018/api.ts";
import { Mip0018Scanner } from "../mip0018/scan.ts";

const NET = "stagenet";
const OUT = process.env.RECORD_OUT;
const RANGES = [
  { name: "idx", from: 714485, to: 715183, cases: ["C01", "C02", "C03", "C04", "C05", "C06", "C07", "C08", "C09", "C10"] },
  { name: "u1", from: 715402, to: 715433, cases: ["U1"] },
] as const;
const HEADERS = ["content-type", "cache-control", "x-content-type-options", "content-security-policy", "referrer-policy"];

interface Answer { path: string; status: number; headers: Record<string, string>; body: string }

let container: StartedPostgreSqlContainer;
const clients: UmbraDBSql[] = [];
const servers: Server[] = [];

beforeAll(async () => {
  if (OUT === undefined) throw new Error("set RECORD_OUT to the directory the answers go to");
  container = await new PostgreSqlContainer("postgres:17-alpine").start();
}, 300_000);

afterAll(async () => {
  for (const s of servers) {
    s.closeAllConnections();
    await new Promise<void>((r) => s.close(() => r()));
  }
  for (const c of clients) await c.end({ timeout: 5 });
  await container?.stop();
}, 60_000);

async function serveRange(range: (typeof RANGES)[number]): Promise<string> {
  const archive = `${range.name}_arch`;
  const mip = `${range.name}_mip`;
  const sql = createClient({ connectionString: container.getConnectionUri(), schema: mip });
  clients.push(sql);
  await bootstrapChainArchiveSchema(sql, archive);
  const f = await startFakeChain(loadRangeTape(range.name));
  try {
    const svc = new ChainArchiveSyncService({
      sql, net: NET, schema: archive, node: { url: f.nodeUrl }, indexer: { url: f.indexerUrl },
      startHeight: range.from, endHeight: range.to, concurrency: 4, backoff: { jitter: false, baseDelayMs: 1, maxDelayMs: 5 },
    });
    expect((await svc.syncOnce({ maxBlocks: 1_000 })).reachedEnd).toBe(true);
  } finally {
    await f.close();
  }
  const scanner = new Mip0018Scanner({ sql, network: NET, schema: mip, archiveSchema: archive });
  await scanner.bootstrap();
  for (;;) {
    const r = await scanner.scanOnce({ maxBlocks: 1_000 });
    if (r.scannedBlocks === 0 || r.reachedEnd) break;
  }
  const server = createMip0018Api({ sql, network: NET, schema: mip, archiveSchema: archive });
  servers.push(server);
  return `http://127.0.0.1:${await listen(server, 0, "127.0.0.1")}`;
}

async function record(base: string, range: (typeof RANGES)[number]): Promise<Answer[]> {
  const answers: Answer[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const visit = async (path: string): Promise<Answer> => {
    const known = answers.find((a) => a.path === path);
    if (known !== undefined) return known;
    const r = await fetch(base + path);
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const h of HEADERS) {
      const v = r.headers.get(h);
      if (v !== null) headers[h] = v;
    }
    const a = { path, status: r.status, headers, body: await r.text() };
    answers.push(a);
    seen.add(path);
    return a;
  };
  await visit("/v1/status");
  const all = JSON.parse((await visit("/v1/tokens?limit=500")).body);
  let cursor: string | null = null;
  do {
    const page = JSON.parse((await visit(`/v1/tokens?limit=2${cursor === null ? "" : `&cursor=${cursor}`}`)).body);
    cursor = page.nextCursor;
  } while (cursor !== null);
  const contracts = new Set<string>();
  for (const it of all.items) {
    if (it.source === "identity") {
      await visit(`/v1/identities/${it.contractAddress}/${it.domainSep}/${it.kind}`);
      contracts.add(it.contractAddress);
    }
    if (it.color !== null) {
      await visit(`/v1/tokens/${it.color}`);
      for (const held of ["shielded", "unshielded"]) await visit(`/v1/lookup/${it.color}?held=${held}`);
    }
  }
  const index = loadCaseIndex();
  for (const c of range.cases) {
    const contract = index.cases[c]?.contract;
    if (typeof contract === "string") contracts.add(contract);
  }
  const txs = new Set<string>();
  for (const c of [...contracts].sort()) {
    await visit(`/v1/contracts/${c}/tokens`);
    const events = JSON.parse((await visit(`/v1/events?contract=${c}&limit=500`)).body);
    for (const e of events.items ?? []) txs.add(e.txHash);
  }
  for (const t of [...txs].sort()) await visit(`/v1/events?tx=${t}`);
  return answers;
}

it("records the answers of both ranges", async () => {
  for (const range of RANGES) {
    const base = await serveRange(range);
    const answers = await record(base, range);
    const file = {
      about: `The MIP-0018 proof of concept's API answers (acedward/umbradb PR #26 at 760d3e9), range ${range.name} (${range.from}–${range.to}), recorded by record-answers.test.ts`,
      range: { name: range.name, from: range.from, to: range.to },
      answers,
    };
    writeFileSync(join(OUT!, `${range.name}.json`), `${JSON.stringify(file, null, 1)}\n`);
  }
}, 900_000);
